verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents splitting each charge between the platform and sellers. Its platform pricing tools let a platform implement a range of processing-pricing strategies without code, which covers taking a cut or markup on transactions. The pack does not explicitly document per-seller pricing, and nothing shows platform payments revenue reported separately from processing costs. missing for 10: explicit per-seller pricing configuration, revenue reporting that separates platform fees from processing costs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, payments are a revenue line — take an application fee or markup on every transaction, set per-seller pricing, and see my payments revenue reported distinctly from processing costs

citations.quote: Create a charge and split payments between your platform and your sellers or service providers.
platforms can implement a range of pricing strategies for different payment processing use-cases, without the need to write any code
